change_types.version_changed: Aurora or Live Data version changed.
change_types.target_changed: Provider/model target or verification metadata changed.
change_types.dependency_changed: One or more validation dependency hashes changed.
change_types.contract_added: A golden contract is newly applied.
change_types.contract_removed: A previously applied golden contract is no longer applied.
change_types.guidance_added: A provider guidance rule is newly applied.
change_types.guidance_removed: A previously applied provider guidance rule is no longer applied.
change_types.guidance_revision_changed: The same guidance rule is present but its verification/source hash changed.
change_types.gate_more_restrictive: The final release gate moved from PASS toward NEEDS_REVIEW or FAIL, or from NEEDS_REVIEW to FAIL.
change_types.gate_less_restrictive: The final release gate moved from FAIL toward NEEDS_REVIEW or PASS, or from NEEDS_REVIEW to PASS.
change_types.gate_unchanged: The final release gate did not change.
change_types.repair_count_changed: The number of repair passes changed.
change_types.unresolved_added: A new unresolved validation item appears.
change_types.unresolved_removed: A previously unresolved validation item is absent.
change_types.fingerprint_changed: Both optional prompt fingerprints exist and differ.
change_types.fingerprint_unchanged: Both optional prompt fingerprints exist and match.

interpretation_rules: Do not infer prompt quality from a version change alone.
Do not infer that the prompt text changed when fingerprints are absent.
A changed dependency hash means the validation environment changed, not necessarily the prompt.
A stricter or looser release gate is a change in validation outcome, not a global quality score.
Missing metadata remains unknown and must not be coerced to false or unchanged.
